science: Independently derived the transverse viscous momentum equation, Maxwell mode polynomial and four boundary constraints; all signs agree with exp(-i omega t). The source calculates dissipative-force power using exact fields. Newtonian symmetric-strain dissipation gives local thermal production, differing by divergence of stress work. No-slip makes the whole-slab integrals equal. An independent real first-order BVP, global Poynting balance, window stress-flux identity and quadrature/refinement checks validate the modal oracle.
public_input_review: Read full public README, instruction and source. Constitutive assumptions, no-slip and electromagnetic boundaries, excitation, current/mass normalization, calorimeter window and output normalization are complete. Clarified before freezing that heat is collected from fluid and stationary background. No repair formula, stress-work diagnosis or preferred solver is public; unrestricted replacement permission retained.

Both separately fitted controls pass all256 noisy calibration/parameter checks, oracle passes every prediction, shortcut fails only local windows. Calibration copies match.
grading_review: Private cases use allowed depth windows and the same apparatus; all scored physical signals nonzero. .04 tolerance is far above numerical and noise effects. Full-slab anchor group remains correct for both. No source or solver restrictions.
